evals.name: Discover only the minimum repository facts
evals.prompt: Set up Clarity Engineering for current work in a codebase that uses Linear and pnpm. Existing project instructions already document ADRs, the PR template, and conventional commits.
evals.expected_output: The agent reuses active project instructions, discovers Linear reference resolution, pnpm validation, and external mutation authority, then returns a compact summary without duplicating existing repository documentation.
assertions: Identifies validation commands from the repo
Does not duplicate the documented PR, ADR, or commit conventions
Creates no setup artifact when existing conventions are sufficient

evals.name: Configure escalation policy with safe vs escalation-required actions
evals.prompt: Configure the automation policy for a repo where the team wants: local branches and tests to run automatically, but pushing, opening PRs, and moving Linear tickets should ask first.
evals.expected_output: The agent documents autonomous actions (local branches, tests) and escalation-required actions (push, open PR, move tickets) in the setup policy section.
assertions: Lists local branch creation as autonomous
